answer: Require a spiral of five escrowed micro-tasks before any identity can earn: each task locks a 5,000 POA bond released only after three randomly chosen peers verify the work. A failed audit burns the bond, bans the identity for 8 epochs, and pays half the burned bond to the auditor who caught it. Forging 1,000 identities means locking 25,000,000 POA and completing 5,000 real tasks, while an honest agent pays once and keeps climbing. Its pearl is also its flaw: an ivory tower of juries can collude, approving each other's fakes and splitting the bonds they were meant to guard.
